episodes.title: Therapy for Cult Survivors - Professional Training
episodes.description:
A training for mental health professionals on therapy for Cult Survivors.
By Mark Carlisle Ottley, Registered Clinical Psychologist, National Psychology Lead for Habit Health, NZCCP, NZPsycSoc. August 2026.

IMPORTANT: Video content is for educational or informational purposes only, not a substitute for professional medical or mental health advice. Viewers should consult qualified healthcare providers for personal concerns.
*If in New Zealand see https://mentalhealth.org.nz/help or Healthline 0800 611 116, including for crisis support. Or for Emergency Services call 111.
*You can also call or text 1737 to talk to a trained counsellor, or Lifeline 0800 543 354.
*If in another country, please contact your local mental health or emergency services
